tha-ap128:2.1: veyyākaraṇo → padake, veyyākaraṇe (bj: sīmu) | veyyākaraṇo → S1 veyyākaraṇe. (pts note)
tha-ap128:3.2: piṭṭhiyaṁ → pīṭhiyaṁ (bj) | pīṭhiyaṁ → piṭṭhiyaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, PTS) | piṭṭhiyaṁ → S2 piṭhiyaṁ; G. vīthiyaṁ. (pts note)
